title: Shorten wizard step indicator labels to prevent wrapping and improve scannability
goal: The wizard stepper shows 7 steps with labels: 'Assessment/Scope Type', 'Credentials Test / Access', 'Test Profile', 'Modules', 'Safety / Limits', 'Review / Confirm'. Several of these wrap on standard viewports. Replace with short single-word or two-word labels: 'Type', 'Scope', 'Access', 'Profile', 'Modules', 'Safety', 'Confirm'. The step number and visual dot already provide position context; the label only needs to identify the step. Update in ui/assets/modules/constants.js where WIZARD_STEPS is defined.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Wizard step indicator labels are verbose multi-word strings with slashes ('Credentials Test / Access', 'Safety / Limits', 'Review / Confirm', 'Assessment/Scope Type') that wrap on viewports narrower than 1280px and are hard to scan at a glance.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Wizard stepper labels wrap and are hard to scan. Short labels improve usability.

acceptance_criteria: No wizard step label exceeds 12 characters.
